record.bible_text: And the LORD<WH03068> spake<WH01696><WTH8762> unto Moses<WH04872>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

Ye shall do<WH06213><WTH8799> my judgments<WH04941>, and keep<WH08104><WTH8799> mine ordinances<WH02708>, to walk<WH03212><WTH8800> therein: I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430>.

Ye shall therefore keep<WH08104><WTH8804> my statutes<WH02708>, and my judgments<WH04941>: which<WH0834> if a man<WH0120> do<WH06213><WTH8799>, he shall live<WH02425><WTH8804> in them: I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>.<CM>

None of you shall approach<WH07126><WTH8799> to any<WH0376> that is near<WH07607> of kin<WH01320> to him, to uncover<WH01540><WTH8763> <FI>their<Fi> nakedness<WH06172>: I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>. <RF>near...: Heb. remainder of his flesh<Rf>

The nakedness<WH06172> of thy sister<WH0269>, the daughter<WH01323> of thy father<WH01>, or daughter<WH01323> of thy mother<WH0517>, <FI>whether she be<Fi> born<WH04138> at home<WH01004>, or born<WH04138> abroad<WH02351>, <FI>even<Fi> their nakedness<WH06172> thou shalt not uncover<WH01540><WTH8762>.

The nakedness<WH06172> of thy son's<WH01121> daughter<WH01323>, or of thy daughter's<WH01323> daughter<WH01323>, <FI>even<Fi> their nakedness<WH06172> thou shalt not uncover<WH01540><WTH8762>: for theirs<WH02007> <FI>is<Fi> thine own nakedness<WH06172>.

The nakedness<WH06172> of thy father's<WH01> wife's<WH0802> daughter<WH01323>, begotten<WH04138> of thy father<WH01>, she <FI>is<Fi> thy sister<WH0269>, thou shalt not uncover<WH01540><WTH8762> her nakedness<WH06172>.
Thou shalt not uncover<WH01540><WTH8762> the nakedness<WH06172> of thy father's<WH01> sister<WH0269>: she <FI>is<Fi> thy father's<WH01> near kinswoman<WH07607>.
Thou shalt not uncover<WH01540><WTH8762> the nakedness<WH06172> of thy mother's<WH0517> sister<WH0269>: for she <FI>is<Fi> thy mother's<WH0517> near kinswoman<WH07607>.

Thou shalt not uncover<WH01540><WTH8762> the nakedness<WH06172> of thy father's<WH01> brother<WH0251>, thou shalt not approach<WH07126><WTH8799> to his wife<WH0802>: she <FI>is<Fi> thine aunt<WH01733>.

Thou shalt not uncover<WH01540><WTH8762> the nakedness<WH06172> of thy daughter in law<WH03618>: she <FI>is<Fi> thy son's<WH01121> wife<WH0802>; thou shalt not uncover<WH01540><WTH8762> her nakedness<WH06172>.
Thou shalt not uncover<WH01540><WTH8762> the nakedness<WH06172> of thy brother's<WH0251> wife<WH0802>: it <FI>is<Fi> thy brother's<WH0251> nakedness<WH06172>.

Thou shalt not uncover<WH01540><WTH8762> the nakedness<WH06172> of a woman<WH0802> and her daughter<WH01323>, neither shalt thou take<WH03947><WTH8799> her son's<WH01121> daughter<WH01323>, or her daughter's<WH01323> daughter<WH01323>, to uncover<WH01540><WTH8763> her nakedness<WH06172>; <FI>for<Fi> they <FI>are<Fi> her near kinswomen<WH07608>: it <FI>is<Fi> wickedness<WH02154>.

Neither shalt thou take<WH03947><WTH8799> a wife<WH0802> to her sister<WH0269>, to vex<WH06887><WTH8800> <FI>her<Fi> , to uncover<WH01540><WTH8763> her nakedness<WH06172>, beside the other in her life<WH02416> <FI>time<Fi> . <RF>a wife...: or, one wife to another<Rf><CM>
Also thou shalt not approach<WH07126><WTH8799> unto a woman<WH0802> to uncover<WH01540><WTH8763> her nakedness<WH06172>, as long as she is put apart<WH05079> for her uncleanness<WH02932>.

And thou shalt not<WH05414><WTH8799> let any of thy seed<WH02233> pass<WH05674><WTH8687> through <FI>the fire<Fi> to Molech<WH04432>, neither shalt thou profane<WH02490><WTH8762> the name<WH08034> of thy God<WH0430>: I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>. <RF>Molech: Gr. Moloch<Rf>
Thou shalt not lie<WH07901><WTH8799> with mankind<WH02145>, as with<WH04904> womankind<WH0802>: it <FI>is<Fi> abomination<WH08441>.

Neither shalt thou<WH05414><WTH8799> lie<WH07903> with any beast<WH0929> to defile<WH02930><WTH8800> thyself therewith: neither shall any woman<WH0802> stand<WH05975><WTH8799> before<WH06440> a beast<WH0929> to lie down<WH07250><WTH8800> thereto: it <FI>is<Fi> confusion<WH08397>.

Ye shall therefore keep<WH08104><WTH8804> my statutes<WH02708> and my judgments<WH04941>, and shall not commit<WH06213><WTH8799> <FI>any<Fi> of these abominations<WH08441>; <FI>neither<Fi> any of your own nation<WH0249>, nor any stranger<WH01616> that sojourneth<WH01481><WTH8802> among<WH08432> you:

Therefore shall ye keep<WH08104><WTH8804> mine ordinance<WH04931>, that <FI>ye<Fi> commit<WH06213><WTH8800> not <FI>any one<Fi> of these abominable<WH08441> customs<WH02708>, which were committed<WH06213><WTH8738> before<WH06440> you, and that ye defile<WH02930><WTH8691> not yourselves therein: I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068> your God<WH0430>.<CM>
